谁懂打开比赛题目列表发现T是一道之前老师布置的难题且没有尝试的救赎感。 没get.zh: 谁懂打开比赛题目列表发现T是一道之前老师布置的难题且没有尝试的救赎感。 没get到为什么标签是贪心。感觉更像升级版冒泡排序。 如果一个数与前面所有数的最大值与最小值都相差d以内，那么它一定可以到开头去。每一次都这么操作，把能够放到开头的元素存到缓存数组中并排序，如果没有就只放开头，并把当前数组加到答案数组末端。
谁懂打开比赛题目列表发现T是一道之前老师布置的难题且没有尝试的救赎感。 没get.en: Anyone who opens the competition problem list and discovers that T is a difficult problem previously assigned by the teacher and not attempted feels a sense of redemption. Didn't get why the tag is greedy. Feels more like an upgraded version of bubble sort. If a number differs from all previous numbers' maximum and minimum by at most d, then it can definitely be moved to the front. Perform this operation each time, store the elements that can be placed at the front in a cache array and sort it; if there are none, just place the front element, and add the current array to the end of the answer array.

根据你对题目的分析和代码实现，这道题 25353: 排队 的核心思想是：.en: According to your analysis of the problem and code implementation, the core idea of Problem 25353: Queueing is:

利用“相邻且身高差 ≤ D 可交换”的规则，推导出可交换的连通块（等价类）； 在.zh: 利用“相邻且身高差 ≤ D 可交换”的规则，推导出可交换的连通块（等价类）； 在每个连通块内部可以任意重排（因为交换具有传递性）； 为了得到字典序最小的序列，对每个连通块内部进行升序排序； 连通块的划分不是显式建图，而是通过贪心扫描 + 极值维护的方式动态确定。 因此，合适的算法标签应包括： ✅ Greedy（贪心） 核心策略：从左到右尽可能早地形成一个合法的“可重排块”，并在块内排序以保证字典序最小。 每轮贪心地扩展当前块，只要加入新元素后仍满足 max - min <= D（等价于所有元素两两之间可通过一系列合法交换连通）。 ✅ Sorting（排序） 每个连通块内部需排序（升序）以获得字典序最小结果。 ✅ Two Pointers / Sliding Window（滑动窗口思想） 虽然代码用的是多轮扫描，但本质是在动态维护一个“当前可合并区间”，类似滑动窗口或分组策略。 更准确地说，是 Iterative Grouping with Range Constraint，但归入滑动窗口或双指针思想也合理。 ✅ Connected Components（连通分量）（可选，偏图论视角） 如果从图论角度理解：若 |h[i] - h[j]| <= D 且 i, j 在同一连通段中（通过相邻合法交换可达），则属于同一分量。 但本题并未显式建图或使用 DFS/BFS，所以这个标签可加但非必需；若平台支持“隐式连通分量”类标签，可考虑。
利用“相邻且身高差 ≤ D 可交换”的规则，推导出可交换的连通块（等价类）； 在.en: Using the rule of 'adjacent and height difference ≤ D can be swapped,' derive the swappable connected blocks (equivalence classes); within each connected block, the elements can be rearranged arbitrarily (because swaps are transitive); to obtain the lexicographically smallest sequence, sort each connected block in ascending order; the division of connected blocks is not done by explicit graph construction but is dynamically determined through greedy scanning + extreme value maintenance. Therefore, the appropriate algorithm tags should include: ✅ Greedy Core strategy: form a valid 'rearrangeable block' as early as possible from left to right, and sort the block internally to ensure the lexicographically smallest sequence. Each round greedily extends the current block as long as adding a new element still satisfies max - min <= D (equivalent to all elements being connected through a series of valid swaps). ✅ Sorting Each connected block needs to be sorted (ascending) to achieve the lexicographically smallest result. ✅ Two Pointers / Sliding Window Although the code uses multiple scans, the essence is dynamically maintaining a 'current mergeable interval,' similar to a sliding window or grouping strategy. More precisely, it is Iterative Grouping with Range Constraint, but categorizing it under sliding window or two-pointer technique is also reasonable. ✅ Connected Components (optional, graph theory perspective) From a graph theory perspective: if |h[i] - h[j]| <= D and i, j are in the same connected segment (reachable through adjacent valid swaps), they belong to the same component. However, this problem does not explicitly construct a graph or use DFS/BFS, so this tag is optional; if the platform supports 'implicit connected components' type tags, it can be considered.

同一个位置不放两个相同的数。具体实现方法为每次只取一串相同数中的第一个没有用过的.en: Do not place two identical numbers in the same position. The specific implementation method is to take only the first unused number from a sequence of identical numbers each time. Note that parentheses are needed around and/or judgments to clarify precedence.

贪心。先将两组马从大到小排序。 如果田忌最大的马比齐王大，那么赢齐王。（这一步最.zh: 贪心。先将两组马从大到小排序。 如果田忌最大的马比齐王大，那么赢齐王。（这一步最优是因为当前齐王的马最大，因此用任何马赢了它都没有损失。） 如果田忌最大的马没有齐王大，那么用最小的马输齐王。（这一步最优是因为无论如何都会输给齐王这匹马，因此用田忌最小的马顶。） 如果田忌最大的马等于齐王最大的马，由于平局不扣钱，那么两步可能的路径是两匹马平局，或者用田忌最小的马输齐王最大的马。不能单从这两匹马判断最优策略，因此先考虑田忌最小的马的用途。 此时如果田忌最小的马大于齐王最小的马，那么赢齐王。（这一步最优是因为这是田忌最小的马，能赢总归是赚的。） 而如果田忌最小的马小于齐王最小的马，那么用这匹马输齐王最大的马。（这匹马无论如何都会输。） 如果田忌最小的马等于齐王最小的马，用这匹马输齐王最大的马更优。（这两组同时平局与相互交叉打的财产均为0，而剩余马贪心的钱财数大于等于安排这两组交叉打的钱财数。） 使用四个指针即可。注意结束循环的条件。
贪心。先将两组马从大到小排序。 如果田忌最大的马比齐王大，那么赢齐王。（这一步最.en: Greedy. First, sort both sets of horses from largest to smallest. If Tian Ji's largest horse is bigger than the King of Qi's, then win against the King of Qi. (This step is optimal because the King of Qi's horse is the largest, so whichever horse beats it gains without loss.) If Tian Ji's largest horse is no bigger than the King of Qi's, then use the smallest horse to lose to the King of Qi's. (This step is optimal because it will lose to this horse of the King of Qi no matter what, so use Tian Ji's smallest horse.) If Tian Ji's largest horse equals the King of Qi's largest horse, since a tie does not deduct money, the two possible paths are to tie these two horses or to use Tian Ji's smallest horse to lose to the King of Qi's largest horse. The optimal strategy cannot be judged from these two horses alone, so first consider the purpose of Tian Ji's smallest horse. At this point, if Tian Ji's smallest horse is bigger than the King of Qi's smallest horse, then win against the King of Qi. (This step is optimal because it is Tian Ji's smallest horse, and winning with it is always a gain.) If Tian Ji's smallest horse is smaller than the King of Qi's smallest horse, then use it to lose to the King of Qi's largest horse. (This horse will lose no matter what.) If Tian Ji's smallest horse equals the King of Qi's smallest horse, it is better to use it to lose to the King of Qi's largest horse. (Tying both pairs and cross-matching them both yield a monetary result of 0, while the greedy winnings from the remaining horses are greater than or equal to those from cross-matching these two pairs.) Four pointers suffice. Pay attention to the loop termination conditions.

贪心。从小到大排序，分成总数相近的两组。相差的值可以通过从较大的那组选取两个电池.en: Greedy. Sort from smallest to largest and divide into two groups with a similar total. The difference can be compensated by selecting two batteries from the larger group to consume some time together. Therefore, it is only necessary to determine whether it can be compensated.

If the number of fish is less than zero, it becomes zero and is pushed back into the heap, so that once all the fish are caught, it stays at the original place. dp[i][j]记为i-j是否回文。状态转移方程dp[i][j]=dp[i+1].zh: dp[i][j]记为i-j是否回文。状态转移方程dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j-1]&(s[i] == s[j]).(从一个回文串向左右扩展。)注意初始赋值，一位的字符串都是回文的。以及注意dp顺序，根据状态转移方程应该按照字符串的长度从小到大更新状态。
dp[i][j]记为i-j是否回文。状态转移方程dp[i][j]=dp[i+1].en: dp[i][j] denotes whether i-j is a palindrome. The state transition equation is dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1] & (s[i] == s[j]) (expanding a palindrome substring outward). Pay attention to the initial values: a single character string is always a palindrome. Also, note the dp order; according to the state transition equation, the state should be updated from shorter to longer substrings.

dp数组记录最后偷第i家的情况下的最高金额。状态转移即考虑前一个偷了哪一家，应当.zh: dp数组记录最后偷第i家的情况下的最高金额。状态转移即考虑前一个偷了哪一家，应当为能偷的所有家里dp的最大值。
dp数组记录最后偷第i家的情况下的最高金额。状态转移即考虑前一个偷了哪一家，应当.en: The dp array records the maximum amount if the i-th house is stolen last. The state transition considers which house was stolen before, taking the maximum dp of all the houses that can be stolen.

状态转移，考虑第i个是吃白花还是红花。吃白花则从dp(i-k)来，吃红花则从dp.zh: 状态转移，考虑第i个是吃白花还是红花。吃白花则从dp(i-k)来，吃红花则从dp(i-1)来。预先把范围内每个数的方案数都算出来，并使用前缀和进行优化。
状态转移，考虑第i个是吃白花还是红花。吃白花则从dp(i-k)来，吃红花则从dp.en: State transition, consider whether the ith one eats a white flower or a red flower. If it eats a white flower, it comes from dp(i-k); if it eats a red flower, it comes from dp(i-1). Precompute the number of solutions for each number in the range and use prefix sums for optimization.

电脑前一天没充上电，于是计概上课打开电脑发现只有29%的电了。然后硬撑了三个小时.en: The computer wasn't charged the day before, so in the Introduction to Computing class, I found that the laptop only had 29% battery. Then I struggled for three hours and battled with a Codeforces in-queue judge for 20 minutes. Finally, within one minute after the class bell rang, the last problem of the homework suddenly got accepted, and the computer still had 3% battery left. Who understands this.

第i个签被最后取出的概率为ai/(a1+a2+……+an)，此时拥有这个数字的最.zh: 第i个签被最后取出的概率为ai/(a1+a2+……+an)，此时拥有这个数字的最后一个人输。因此开两个字典分别记录数字的个数以及持有它的最后一个人。每个人输掉的概率即为抽到最后一个签的概率相加。
第i个签被最后取出的概率为ai/(a1+a2+……+an)，此时拥有这个数字的最.en: The probability that the ith lot is taken last is ai / (a1 + a2 +... + an); at this time, the last person holding this number loses. Therefore, open two dictionaries to record the count of each number and the last person holding it. The probability that each person loses is the sum of the probabilities of drawing the last lot.

1.撞到x轴则y方向取反，撞到y轴则x方向取反 2.被撞的球不会改变位置，只需记.en: 1. When hitting the x-axis, reverse the y-direction; when hitting the y-axis, reverse the x-direction. 2. The ball being hit does not change position; just record whether it is the black ball or the white ball moving. Hitting a ball once toggles the flag by XOR once.

单调栈。每当遇到比栈顶小的数就将栈中所有更大的数弹出，并加入当前数，直到k次删除.en: Monotonic stack. Whenever a number smaller than the top of the stack is encountered, pop all larger numbers from the stack and add the current number, until k removals are used up. If not all removals are used, delete elements from the bottom of the stack.

dfs饭票的所有面值。对dfs进行剪枝，饭票的面值应大于上一次面值，小于当前连续.zh: dfs饭票的所有面值。对dfs进行剪枝，饭票的面值应大于上一次面值，小于当前连续覆盖最大值-1.计算当前连续覆盖最大值的方法是dp，dp数组记录凑出面值i的最少饭票数，每dfs一次就更新dp数组。 注意题目要求的是凑出1-n，同时不能凑出n+1.以及多测记得清空。
dfs饭票的所有面值。对dfs进行剪枝，饭票的面值应大于上一次面值，小于当前连续.en: DFS all denominations of the meal tickets. Perform pruning on DFS: the denomination of the meal ticket should be greater than the previous denomination and less than the current maximum consecutively covered value minus 1. The method to calculate the current maximum consecutively covered value is DP; the DP array records the minimum number of meal tickets needed to form value i, and the DP array is updated on each DFS. Note that the problem requires forming 1 to n while not being able to form n+1. Also, remember to clear for multiple test cases.

双端取数的博弈问题的dp。dp数组记录剩余数字为第i-j时先手能比后手多出的最多.zh: 双端取数的博弈问题的dp。dp数组记录剩余数字为第i-j时先手能比后手多出的最多的分。考虑先手取对头或队尾，此时后手变成了先手，由此可以使用dp数据递推。 建立dp表的顺序应枚举字段长度与开头下标。边界为只剩一个数的时候，此时数组那个数的值即为先手多出的分数。
双端取数的博弈问题的dp。dp数组记录剩余数字为第i-j时先手能比后手多出的最多.en: Dynamic programming for the double-ended number taking game. The dp array records the maximum score the first player can lead over the second player when the remaining numbers are from index i to j. Consider the first player taking from the front or end; then the second player becomes the first player, allowing the use of dp data for recursion. The order of building the dp table should enumerate the subarray length and starting index. The boundary is when there is only one number left; at this time, the value of that number in the array is the score the first player can gain.
